findings.title: Lethal trifecta: untrusted input + private data + external sink
findings.detail: Server "ai" exposes tools that together enable an exfiltration flow. Untrusted content: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, describe, ai_translate, ai_extract_json, ai_answer, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_classify, transcribe_summary, text_to_speech_lite · Private data: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, transcribe, ai_summarize_text, ai_translate, ai_rerank, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, subtitles_translate · Public sink: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, transcribe, image, ai_summarize_text, ai_rerank, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_outline, transcribe_long, transcribe_summary, voice_agent, dub, transcribe_speakers · Destructive: transcribe_long, subtitles_translate.

evidence.snippet: Untrusted content: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, describe, ai_translate, ai_extract_json, ai_answer, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_classify, transcribe_summary, text_to_speech_lite · Private data: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, transcribe, ai_summarize_text, ai_translate, ai_rerank, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, subtitles_translate · Public sink: ai_chat, ai_chat_large, transcribe, image, ai_summarize_text, ai_rerank, ai_model_gpt_oss_20b, ai_model_gpt_oss_120b, ai_model_mistral_small, ai_model_qwen_coder, ai_outline, transcribe_long, transcribe_summary, voice_agent, dub, transcribe_speakers · Destructive: transcribe_long, subtitles_translate

findings.remediation: Do not co-install these capabilities under one trust boundary; an injected comment/email can steer the model to exfiltrate via the sink tool.
